text:
lina: customer ACME reported a sudden spike in invoice failures after yesterday's billing migration. Multiple invoices show `declined` with `auth_required` and a 3DS step that never completed.

ashwin: can you paste one of the raw event logs? merchant id and txn id (no PII) please.

lina: sure, here's a scrubbed log — txn id: txn_9z7g, merchant: acme_corp, response: `{\n  status: "declined",\n  decline_code: "3ds_challenge_timeout",\n  acs: "timeout",\n  gateway_code: "AUTH_TIMEOUT"\n}`

jordan: did the acquirer switch during the migration? that can change ACS endpoints/headers.

lina: yes, merchant moved from acquirer-oldbank -> acquirer-newpay during maintenance window (12:30-12:45 UTC). Failures started ~12:40.

ashwin: interesting. sounds like redirect/relay headers might be dropped by our proxy. can you repro with curl simulating the IRN? small snippet below — use a test card that triggers 3DS challenge.

lina: posting repro steps I used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/payments/charge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"merchant_id":"acme_corp","amount":5000,"currency":"EUR","payment_method":{"type":"card","number":"4000000000003220","expiry":"12/28"},"return_url":"https://acme.example/3ds-cb"}'
```

billing-bot: webhook delivered status=200 to acme.example/callback 12:42:11 UTC (latency 280ms)

lina: response from our API was 402 + body `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"3ds_challenge_timeout\",\"message\":\"ACS did not respond in time\"}}`

jordan: can you dump the proxy logs around 12:40-12:43? specifically look for `Location` header rewrites and any dropped `Set-Cookie` or `Content-Security-Policy` that could break the ACS iframe.

lina: grabbed proxy snippet: `WARN proxy: missing header Location for txn_9z7g` and `DEBUG proxy: stripping cookies for cross-site redirect to https://acs-newpay.example`

ashwin: that cookie stripping rings alarm bells — ACS often relies on session cookies for challenge flow. If we remove them, ACS returns no challenge and times out. This would explain `3ds_challenge_timeout`.

marie: customer is asking for next steps + whether we can retry the pending invoices automatically. they have a monthly PO coming due tomorrow.

ashwin: short term: we can attempt server-side retry for affected transactions with the previous acquirer endpoint if available. but safer fix is to stop stripping cookies on cross-site redirects for known ACS domains. I'll put a hotfix request.

jordan: agree. patch suggestion: allowlist ACS domains in proxy config and preserve `Set-Cookie` + `Location` for 3ds flows. config snippet: `proxy.allowlist_acs = ["acs-newpay.example","acs.oldbank.example"]`

lina: filed ticket SUP-4823 with logs + repro. adding @ashwin and @jordan.

ops-bot: incident created SUP-4823, priority=P2, assigned to Payments + Eng.

ashwin: followups: 1) can we trigger a targeted retry for `txn_9z7g`-style failures? 2) customer wants an ETA and a note for the invoices.

jordan: ETA for config hotfix — I can roll a change to proxy tomorrow morning in 2-hour window, then run a small batch of retries. I'll coordinate with Ops.

marie: I'll message the customer: temporary workaround is to instruct them to pause autopay for invoices created between 12:35-12:50 UTC while we retry; offer to manually process retries once the patch is live.

lina: testing note: to reproduce locally, use the test card above and set `X-Forwarded-Host` to `acs-newpay.example` to emulate the acquirer redirect. I confirmed challenge iframe shows when cookies are preserved.

ashwin: one more ask — please collect 3 example txns across different amounts and currencies so we can test across tokenization paths.

lina: will do, uploading to SUP-4823 now. thanks all :thumbsup:
